messages:
sam: quick ask — I need a short checklist for where to look for TTFT (time_to_first_token) + tokens/sec breakdowns by model. Trying to tune the p95 alert and add a small per-model tokens/sec panel. any pointers? :thinking:

anya: start with Grafana -> Observability / Latency dashboards. two quick panels I use: 'TTFT by model (histogram_quantile p50/p95/p99)' and 'Tokens/sec by model (rate over 1m)'. links: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/Obs-latency/ttft-overview and https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/Obs-throughput/model-tokens

mike: to be concrete, for TTFT p95 use this PromQL on our prometheus: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
and for tokens/sec: 
```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (model)
```
These are what our dashboard panels use.

sam: thanks — where are the panel bookmarks or saved links? want to link them in the alert PR.

anya: bookmark the panels (three-dot -> share -> link). If you want a compact view, use the panel permalink. For the alert PR reference the internal dash id (e.g., dashId=1011). I usually paste the direct panel link in the alert description.

jess: small ops note — logs can help correlate cold-starts. use Loki query: 
```
{job="inference"} |= "started kv cache" |~ "model=\"(.*)\""
```
This gives you requests that triggered cache warm-up which often spikes TTFT.

mike: if tuning alert threshold, watch tokens/sec and instance count. If tokens/sec drops < X for a model, TTFT p95 will artificially look better. So tune with weight on tail + throughput. Also add a suppression window for rollout periods.

sam: for the PR, what's the canonical alert rule format?

anya: we use prometheus alertmanager rules in infra/monitoring/alerts. example snippet you can copy: 
```yaml
- alert: TTFT_P95_High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model)) > 0.6
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
    owner: eng-platform
  annotations:
    summary: "TTFT p95 high for {{ $labels.model }}"
    description: "p95 TTFT > 600ms for model {{ $labels.model }} (5m)",
    runbook: "https://wiki.redwood.ai/obs/ttft-runbook"
```

sam: perfect. can someone with alert perms add a suppression rule for deploys? don't want noisy pages during canaries. @mike? :pray:

mike: I can add a temporary silence and then we should add a tag-based suppression in alertmanager. Filing a quick issue to track: https://issues.redwood.ai/ENG-obs-312

observability-bot: Reminder: alert-rule validation failed on a similar patch earlier — please run `make alert-lint` in infra/monitoring before opening the PR.

sam: good call — I'll run lint and attach the panel links + prometheus snippet in the PR description. anyone want to review the thresholds? proposing 0.6s for p95 across mid/high tiers, 1.0s for free-tier models.

jess: I can take a quick look after lunch. If you can capture a 24h heatmap screenshot and tokens/sec trend for each model in the PR that helps. :+1:

anya: one more pointer: traces for TTFT come from jaeger span `first_token` — filter by span and look at p95 there if you want independent verification. jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=inference&span=first_token

sam: awesome — checklist captured. I'll open the PR with: panel links, promql, alertrule snippet, lint output, 24h screenshots, and a runbook link. thanks all :rocket:
